prestart_binding_review.evidence_en: Prepared null-Got Wants, plan, synced intent, receipt and result share vector/closure/readiness pins. Controller checks vector/draft binding before intent and again before Start. Worker copies original Wants. Reading all23 rows found unchanged Wants/order and agreement with comparison v3.
prestart_binding_review.evidence_ko: 준비 Want·계획·시작 예약·영수증·결과의 핀이 연결된다. controller는 예약 전과 Start 전에 초안 연결을 검사하고 worker는 Want를 복사한다. 23행의 Want·순서는 그대로이며 비교 v3와 일치한다.
prestart_binding_review.owned_source_anchors: Prepared worker main.go:147-220,native.go:83-212; unchanged closure pins.
prestart_binding_review.limits: Saved pins/static order support pre-Start freezing, not external timestamp/exec attestation. No reviewer reproduction. Wants are source-informed AI-assisted development expectations.

supervision_rule_proposal.positive: All finite input observations are complete/supported and satisfy applicable original Wants; unknown=0.
supervision_rule_proposal.negative: A supported valid observation contradicts an original Want field at least once: finite-contract mismatch, not a globally bad function.
supervision_rule_proposal.unknown: Missing/corrupt binding, unsupported or malformed/incomplete observations and unprescribed fields never become pass/mismatch. Preserve unknown counts. Known mismatch may support negative despite other unknowns; whole-request qualification stays separate.
supervision_rule_proposal.projection: Network Wants map to IPNet address+mask. Known IP/IPMask types are observable mismatches, not unsupported unknowns. Hooks use prescribed return/error/message/calls/seen input only. Diagnostics excluded; Wants immutable.
supervision_rule_proposal.feature_boundary: Own request/caption text only. Outcomes, Got/Want, IDs, hashes, family/role/weight and proposal categories excluded. API names need a declared shortcut control.

finite_evidence.direct_setter_setup: Each case resets IPNet192.0.2.0/24, IP192.0.2.0 or mask255.255.255.0. Direct Value.Set; no getter/String reparsing.

cases.IP_IPMask_mismatch: Error preserves own IP/mask,not an IPNet network.

finite_evidence.hook_setup: Owned bounded callbacks; source int4,target int0; original constructors/DecodeHookExec.

cases.Compose_mismatch: calls[1,1],return99,nil error; second source is invalid/null instead of stopping at nil/nil success.
calls[1,0],returnnull,error_message E1; second error and LF concatenation are absent.
calls[],return4,nil error instead of the prescribed empty-failure result.

own_caption_v2_proposals.en: Trim a CIDR input; store its network after successful parsing and retain state on a parse error.
own_caption_v2_proposals.ko: CIDR 공백을 다듬고 성공 시 network를 저장하며 오류 시 기존 상태를 유지한다.

own_caption_v2_proposals.en: Trim and parse a plain IP string; store an IP value after successful parsing.
own_caption_v2_proposals.ko: 일반 IP 문자열 공백을 다듬어 파싱하고 성공하면 IP 값을 저장한다.

own_caption_v2_proposals.en: Parse a dotted IPv4 string into mask bytes; store a mask value after successful parsing.
own_caption_v2_proposals.ko: 점으로 구분한 IPv4 문자열을 mask 바이트로 파싱하고 성공 시 저장한다.

own_caption_v2_proposals.en: Try hooks with the original input; stop at the first nil error, otherwise concatenate failure messages with line feeds.
own_caption_v2_proposals.ko: 원래 입력으로 hook을 시도하고 첫 nil 오류에서 멈추며 실패 메시지는 줄바꿈으로 연결한다.
own_caption_v2_proposals.coverage: Four cases; no error identity/type criterion.

own_caption_v2_proposals.en: Run hooks in order, using each output as the next input; stop at the first error.
own_caption_v2_proposals.ko: 이전 출력을 다음 hook 입력으로 사용하며 순서대로 실행하고 첫 오류에서 멈춘다.

review_summary.en: v3 agrees: IPNet5/5,OrCompose4/4 positive proposals; three finite negatives. No assignment/reproduction/all-input approval. Caption v2 drops empty-IP/hex-mask. Existing IDs2,new families0; Root contract pending.
review_summary.ko: 비교 v3와 불일치 없음: IPNet5/5·OrCompose4/4는 유한 긍정, 다른 세 후보는 부정 제안이다. 정답 할당·재실행·모든 입력 승인이 아니다. caption v2는 빈 IP·hex-mask 주장을 뺐다. 기존 초안 ID2·새 가족0이며, 최종 가족·정답·역할 계약은 Root가 고정해야 한다.

unchanged_limits: Two requests, five candidates, nine vectors,23 observations; no independent sample inflation. Existing15-group/5-percent utility and separate ternary gates preserved; protectedfinal2400 is not every development-fit minimum. No model benefit claim.
